intro: One playthrough, roughly 200 hours, no difficulty trophies and no online trophies. The order below is built from the official trophy descriptions and the sources cited in the checklist: story first, with the right saves; side stories after the credits; the 100% checklist last.

stages.text: This platinum is a save-management exercise before it is anything else: there is no mission replay and no New Game Plus. The game gives you 15 manual save slots plus an autosave — keep one save at the start of every chapter, rotate the rest, and never overwrite your only copy. Never use cheats on your trophy save: they switch off trophies and saving. Exactly one trophy can be missed, and it is flagged here because the next stage is where you save it.
stages.title: Set up before you start

stages.text: Play Chapter 1 slowly. After Lucia comes home, on a morning after the mission Down to Earth, she steps out onto the balcony of Jason's house to meditate — follow her and accept the task, because that spot disappears when Chapter 1 ends and Positive Mental Attitude may need it. Cal's fishing challenge and an arcade game are also available this early; clear both now while the map is small.
stages.title: Chapter 1 — the one missable

stages.text: The campaign unlocks the list chapter by chapter. Chapter 2 brings character switching (right after Breakfast Run), the garage app (Daily Driver), Scooter Bros registrations (Moses) and the Kingpin Bowling job. Chapter 3 brings the Snap Gun jewelry robberies, the three-shop partner chain, and the time-sensitive Race Against Yago — run it on sight. Late in Chapter 4, the optional mission That's Where The Money Is opens the bank vaults. Keep banking a save at each chapter start as you go.
stages.title: Chapters 2 to 4 — the toolbox opens

stages.text: Play the final mission for the gold story trophy. Before you start it, set aside one manual save and never touch it again: with no mission replay, that untouched save is your insurance for anything the cleanup turns up.
stages.title: Finish the story
trophies: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

stages.text: All six side-story finales stay available after the credits, so nothing here is urgent: Andy (Lucia-only), Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone (Jason-only) and Bret's hunting line (Jason-only). Separately, complete 8 stranger strands for Strangers & Freaks — the Andy, Billy and Tyrone strands do not count toward it, so watch that trophy's own progress counter as strands end.
stages.title: Side stories and strangers

stages.text: Now the crime shelf. Rob bank vaults with your partner aboard (the 4-star escape doubles as Hot Together), hit an armored truck, rob one illegal operation per gang, and fence the Marked Bills the jobs produce. Then the one-offs: a jet taken from a VCIA boarding bridge, a tank at Mile Zero Air Station, five takedowns inside one Combat Focus, gym training until both heroes max their Strength, and the Criminal Profile actions that accumulate as you play.
stages.title: Crime and one-offs in free roam

stages.text: What remains is the 100% checklist behind A Long Road, and its targets overshoot the trophies: 300 stunts, 70 of the 80 Challenges, 200 of the 277 vehicles, all 39 gang operations, all 8 bank vaults, 15 card sets. The five hidden trophies with no confirmed method may pop anywhere along this road — there is nothing to schedule for them. When the last of the other 54 lands, Vice Got a Price! closes the list.
stages.time: The long tail — about 200 hours in all
stages.title: The 100% checklist, then the platinum
